description: This PHP source file defines the class StandardField, which extends DynamicField, responsible for parsing and managing custom and base definitions of dynamic fields within the SuiteCRM platform. The class includes methods to load custom and base definitions from specific files, add field objects with support for unified search, and manage field definitions including defaults and overrides.

classes.name: StandardField
classes.description: Class responsible for handling dynamic field definitions, including custom and base definitions, in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadCustomDef
methods.description: Loads custom field definition from a specific file if it exists for the given field.

methods.name: loadBaseDef
methods.description: Loads base field definition from the module's vardefs if it exists for the given field.

methods.name: addFieldObject
methods.description: Adds and updates a field object into the current field definitions, supporting unified search flags and handling defaults and overrides.
